scope: Initial/final registers, RAM and queue; ordered bus address/data/lanes and clock per transaction, for the 85 instruction groups the other fixtures do not hold. Native and reference paths.
selection: Deterministic, from inputs only: of the vectors without the trace bit, without a bus or address error and whose code fits the harness image, every 8th in file order; register-count shifts and rotates also those with a count (mod 64) of 0, 31, 32 or 63. See tools/build_m68000_groups_fixture.py.
excluded: Odd-address and bus errors, trace-bit vectors, memory-operand shifts, TAS, TRAPV, RESET, the groups of the other fixtures and later CPUs. FC retained but not routed or compared. Undefined flags are masked where the Motorola manual leaves them undefined (sr_mask).
